snippet.title: My Name Is Crocodilo - (Official Music Video) | CROCOCO GAME
snippet.description:
The CROCOCO song became such a hit that our friends decided it deserved its own music video. 
We completely agreed. 🐊 
Now let's do the same thing with the game. 
The song is becoming the hit of the summer.
Let's make CROCOCO the hit of the summer too.
Wishlist it. Play it. Share it.
See you in the sewers. 🌍
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4699110/Crococo
